description: This source file defines classes related to metadata descriptors for PDF dictionary keys in the PDFsharp library. It includes the KeyDescriptor class for individual key metadata and the DictionaryMeta class for managing collections of such descriptors within PDF dictionaries.

classes.name: KeyDescriptor
classes.description: Contains metadata about a specific key in a PDF dictionary, including its type, version, fixed value, and object type.

classes.name: DictionaryMeta
classes.description: Maintains metadata descriptors for all keys in a specific PDF dictionary type, allowing retrieval of key descriptors by key name.

methods.name: KeyDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a KeyDescriptor instance based on a KeyInfoAttribute, setting properties like version, key type, fixed value, and object type.

methods.name: GetValueType
methods.description: Returns the .NET Type that corresponds to the value for the described key, based on the KeyType and ObjectType properties.

methods.name: DictionaryMeta
methods.description: Constructor that initializes key descriptors by reflecting over a given type's public static fields with KeyInfoAttribute annotations. Overloaded constructor also sets default content key and type.

methods.name: this[string key]
methods.description: Indexer to retrieve the KeyDescriptor for a given key string; returns a default descriptor if the key is not explicitly defined.
